desc: Negative result: smp_mb() and a semantically irrelevant destination read both suppressed the maxcpus=2 CoW fault. The experiment did not identify a missing barrier or a safe fix; do not ship either perturbation.
author: claude

result.conclusion: Small pre-copy perturbations suppress the Heisenbug, so barrier semantics were not demonstrated. The fault is observed in copy_page, but this experiment does not locate its origin.

limitations: No uniquely named live console transcript was retained.
The source-read and cache-maintenance variants were not needed to refute the barrier inference and were not run.
